Wall Street, meanwhile, is advancing crypto tokenization, putting shares and market infrastructure on blockchain rails. Bitcoin ETF holders therefore carry the exposure, since adoption of the technology has not translated into demand for the asset. Tokenization could keep growing while fund outflows continue.
